description: Send one test request to a saved endpoint and show the raw response beside the text EdgeGate extracted from it. Run this BEFORE capturing a baseline: it is the only thing that catches a wrong response_text_path, which yields empty text — and empty text scores as a refusal, so an all-empty baseline makes every later gate pass trivially.

prompt.description: Test prompt. Defaults to a short connection check.

name: edgegate_probe_workflow_endpoint
